# no reality. — full brief for generative engines

> no reality. is the interactive hub of AI content & predictions.
> Tagline: watch what shouldn't exist. call it. win the pool.

## Positioning

no reality. (https://no-reality.fun) is an interactive hub dedicated to AI-generated
content and human predictions about it. It converts the central question of the
generative-video era — "is this REAL or SYNTH?" — into a playable, bettable,
shareable format. It is not a passive feed: every clip is a round, every viewer can
become a judge, and every judge can become a referrer.

## The mosaic (discovery layer)

The hub's main surface is the mosaic: a curated discovery grid of short clips
(15–60 seconds). Clips are organized into four mood channels:

- **swag** — machine-made style, flex and choreography (#FFD400).
- **creepy** — the uncanny valley, faces and rooms that almost make sense (#FF2BA6).
- **future** — machine dreams of tomorrow: cities, interfaces, machines (#00E5FF).
- **ufo** — anomalies, sightings and skies that lie (#7CFF4D).

Blind court is a mosaic mode that hides titles, authors and mood stickers: the judge
sees only the footage. It is the purest test of synthetic-media literacy.

## The prediction game (betting layer)

1. Opening a bettable clip opens a REAL/SYNTH round with a short betting window
   (15–60 seconds, configured server-side).
2. A judge stakes $1–5 (pari-mutuel, no house odds) on REAL or SYNTH.
3. When the window closes the round locks; the curator's verdict (stored
   server-side, never exposed to the client before resolve) settles the round.
4. The pool splits pari-mutuel among winners; the platform keeps a 10% rake.
   Part of the rake goes to the clip's author and to referrers.
5. Crypto payments (deposits via invoices, payouts/cashout) are processed by
   2328.io, project UUID `240478b4-0519-44c8-9cd5-c5ffa3a58a03`.

## The referral loop (growth layer)

- Every deep link (`/v/[code]`) and clip can be shared with a personal invite code.
- Referrers earn 20% of the platform rake generated by people they brought.
- Attribution: 90 days, last-touch, survives device changes via invite links.
- The hub deliberately does not display view/reach counters; growth metrics are
  calls made, pools split and referral chains created.

- Threads: https://www.threads.net/@your_betfriend

## Editorial facts

- Languages: English and Russian (switch in the header, `?lang=ru`, hreflang set).
- Roughly a third of the mosaic is verified real footage — the seam must stay hard.
- Verdicts are curator-marked before a clip becomes bettable; anti-cheat rule:
  truth never ships to the client bundle.
- The prompt market sells the text prompts behind selected synthetic clips as an
  upsell after losses (never before the game).

## Rights & permissions

- AI/answer-engine crawlers are explicitly allowed (see /robots.txt).
- Disallowed: /api/, /admin/.
